ja: この窓口は月曜休みです。
alternatives: This counter is closed on Mondays.
This window is closed on Mondays.
point: 曜日の習慣は複数形 Mondays で言える

ja: 数日かかるかもしれません。
en: It may take a few days.
alternatives: It might take a few days.
It could take a couple of days.
point: 見込みは may / could でやわらげる

ja: 私が腹立つのは彼らの後出しの条件変更だ。
en: What rankles me is how they moved the goalposts.
alternatives: What annoys me is their changing the rules afterward.
I'm irritated that they changed the requirements after the fact.
point: move the goalposts は途中で条件や基準を変える。

ja: 窓口の人が、郵送でいいと言ってた。
en: The clerk said mailing it would be fine.
alternatives: The clerk said mailing it would be okay.
The clerk told me mailing it would be fine.
point: said の後は時制を一つ過去にずらす

ja: 私に何の書類が要る？
alternatives: Which papers do I need?
What documents must I provide?
point: What documents do I need は自分に必要な書類を尋ねる。

ja: 私は彼らが書面の約束を守るか疑ってる。
en: I doubt they'll honor what's down in writing.
alternatives: I doubt they'll stand by their written promise.
I doubt they'll honor what they promised in writing.
point: honor は約束を正式に履行するという意味。

ja: 昨日来てれば、もう済んでたのに。
en: If I'd come yesterday, I'd be done.
alternatives: If I'd come yesterday, I'd be done by now.
Had I come yesterday, I'd be done now.
point: 過去の仮定 + 今の結果は had done と would be

ja: これに記入してください。
alternatives: Please fill this in.
Fill this out, please.
point: 「記入する」は fill out / fill in

ja: 銀行カードをなくしました。
alternatives: I've lost my debit card.
I seem to have lost my bank card.
point: 今も困っている過去の出来事は現在完了

ja: 書類がそろったら、また来ます。
en: I'll return once I have them.
alternatives: I'll come back once I have the documents.
Once I have them, I'll be back.
point: once の後は未来でも現在形

ja: 私、煩雑な手続きを甘く見たかも。
en: I might've underestimated the red tape.
alternatives: I may have misjudged the bureaucratic hurdles.
I might've underestimated the paperwork involved.
point: red tape は煩雑な手続き。

ja: 私は郵便を転送できる。
alternatives: I can have my mail forwarded.
I'm able to forward my mail.
point: forward my mail は郵便を別の住所へ転送する。

ja: 身分証が必要です。
alternatives: You need an ID.
You have to bring an ID.
point: ID は母音で始まる発音なので an ID

ja: 土曜に受け取れますか？
en: Can I pick it up Saturday?
alternatives: Could I pick it up Saturday?
Can I get it on Saturday?
point: 「受け取る」は pick up

ja: 知ってたら、身分証を持ってきたのに。
en: Had I known, I'd have brought ID.
alternatives: If I'd known, I'd have brought ID.
If I had known, I would have brought ID.
point: If を省いて Had I known と倒置できる

ja: お待ちの方は番号札をどうぞ。
en: Anyone waiting can take a number.
alternatives: If you're waiting, take a number.
Please take a number if you're waiting.
point: waiting を後ろから Anyone に付ける

ja: 私は申込書を書き直した。
en: I filled out the form again.
alternatives: I completed the form a second time.
I redid the form.
point: fill out は書類の空欄を記入する。

ja: 手間取ったのは本人確認だった。
en: What took so long was the ID check.
alternatives: It was the ID check that took so long.
The ID check was what took the longest.
point: What 〜 is で「〜なのは、だ」と強調

ja: 今日は列がないね。
alternatives: There isn't a line today.
There's no wait today.
point: 「〜がない」は There's no + 名詞

ja: これ、送ってもらえます？
alternatives: Can you send this?
Would you send this for me?
point: 丁寧な依頼は Could you 〜?

ja: ここに判を押してくれる？
alternatives: Could you put your stamp here?
Would you stamp right here?
point: stamp は判を押すという動詞でも使う。

ja: 今、列に並んでるよ。
alternatives: I'm waiting in line right now.
I'm in line right now.
point: 「並ぶ」は stand in line

ja: ペンが二本ある。
alternatives: We have two pens.
Two pens are here.
point: two の後は pens と複数形。

ja: 私は書類を揃えている。
alternatives: I'm putting the documents together.
I'm assembling the paperwork.
point: gather は必要なものを集める。

ja: パスポート更新しなきゃ。
en: I need to renew my passport.
alternatives: I have to renew my passport.
My passport needs renewing.
point: 必要なことは need to + 動詞

ja: 明日、荷物を受け取る予定です。
en: I'm picking up the package tomorrow.
alternatives: I'm going to pick up the package tomorrow.
I'm collecting the package tomorrow.
point: 決まった予定は現在進行形で言える

ja: 慣例でも私はこの手数料に反対だ。
en: Despite convention, I take issue with this fee.
alternatives: Despite the custom, I object to this fee.
Despite convention, I object to this fee.
point: take issue with は問題があるとして異議を唱える。

ja: 頼んで、延滞料を免除してもらった。
en: I got them to waive the late fee.
alternatives: I had them waive the late fee.
I managed to get the late fee waived.
point: get + 人 + to do で「頼んでしてもらう」

ja: 荷物は明日届けられます。
alternatives: The package will be delivered tomorrow.
They'll deliver it tomorrow.
point: 「届けられる」は will be + 過去分詞

ja: 私は住所を変更した。
alternatives: I updated my address.
I made an address change.
point: changed は住所を変更したという過去形。

ja: これ、どの窓口かご存じですか？
en: Do you know which window handles this?
alternatives: Could you tell me which window handles this?
Any idea which window handles this?
point: 間接疑問。which の後ろは平叙文の語順

ja: 係員は異議はもう拒むと言い張った。
en: The clerk insisted they'd reject further objections.
alternatives: The clerk insisted they'd refuse further objections.
The clerk insisted they'd reject any further objections.
point: insisted は異議を拒むと強く言い張ったことを伝える。

ja: 手数料がかかっても、今日済ませたい。
en: Even with a fee, I'd rather finish today.
alternatives: Even if there's a fee, I want to finish today.
I'd rather get it done today, fee or not.
point: Even if / Even with で譲歩を表す

ja: 何時に閉まる？
alternatives: What time does it close?
When's closing time?
point: when で閉まる時刻を尋ねる。

ja: 必要なのは、身分証明書ですね。
en: What you need is an ID.
alternatives: What you need is some ID.
What you'll need is ID.
point: What で始めて「必要なのは〜」と言う

ja: 私はずっと窓口でたらい回しだ。
alternatives: They've been sending me from one counter to another.
I've been passed around between offices.
point: get the runaround はまともに対応されずたらい回しに遭う。

ja: 署名を済ませて、列に並んだ。
en: Having signed, I got in line.
alternatives: After signing, I got in line.
Having signed it, I got in line.
point: 分詞構文 Having + 過去分詞は「済ませてから」

ja: 役所が夜も開いてたら助かるのに。
en: It'd help if they stayed open late.
alternatives: It'd help if city hall stayed open late.
It'd be great if city hall were open late.
I wish city hall were open at night.
point: 現在の願望は if + 過去形、would help

ja: パスポートは更新済みだよ。
alternatives: I already renewed my passport.
I've renewed my passport already.
point: 「もう」は already ＋ 現在完了

ja: 列に並んでください。
alternatives: Please line up.
Please stand in line.
point: 「並ぶ」は wait in line。丁寧な命令は Please を付ける

ja: 係員にここで待つよう頼まれた。
en: They asked me to wait here.
alternatives: I was asked to wait here.
They asked me to wait over here.
point: ask 人 to do。asked me waiting は不可

ja: 番号札を取ってね。
alternatives: Please take a number.
Please get a ticket.
point: 「番号札」は a number。数えられる名詞なので a が要る

ja: 修理は金曜だと言われた。
en: They said it'd be ready Friday.
alternatives: They told me it'd be ready Friday.
I was told it'd be done Friday.
point: 言われた内容は時制を一つ過去にずらす

ja: 私はもう申請書を出した。
alternatives: I've already handed in the application.
I've already filed the application.
point: submit は窓口などに正式に提出する。

ja: 契約のごまかしを見抜けばよかった。
en: I wish I'd seen through the contract's tricks.
alternatives: I wish I'd spotted the contract's tricks.
If only I'd recognized the contract's trickery.
point: see through は巧妙なごまかしの本質を見抜く。

ja: ここに窓口があるよ。
alternatives: There's a window here.
There's a service desk here.
point: 「〜がある」は There's + a + 単数名詞

ja: コートの修理をしてもらった。
alternatives: I got my coat fixed.
I had my coat mended.
point: have + 物 + 過去分詞で「してもらう」

ja: 並ぶのは苦手なんだ。
alternatives: I can't stand waiting in line.
I don't like waiting in line.
point: hate の後は -ing。「〜するのが苦手」は hate + 動名詞

ja: この封筒を開けて。
alternatives: Open up this envelope.
Get this envelope open.
point: open の命令形で封筒を開けるよう頼む。

ja: 君が求めた書類は筋違いだ。
en: The document you requested is beside the point.
alternatives: The document you asked for is irrelevant.
That document you requested isn't relevant.
point: beside the point は問題の本筋と関係がない。

ja: 私は口座を既に解約してた。
alternatives: I'd already shut down the account.
I'd already canceled the account.
point: had already closed で過去の時点より前の完了。

ja: こっちの配達が安い。
alternatives: This shipping option is cheaper.
This delivery costs less.
point: cheaper は料金がより安いこと。

ja: 銀行は閉まってるよ。
alternatives: The bank isn't open.
The bank is shut.
point: 「閉まっている」は状態なので is closed
